era: 2019 walmart.com (2018 redesign, used through 2019 by every desktop visitor): navy #041e42 bar with the yellow spark only, a square white search field with a bold 'Search' placeholder, white outline icons (reorder, account, store, cart) without labels, white page with Bogle type, blue #0071dc pill buttons, white footer with link columns. The crawler captures (s1, s2, s4, s5) and a user's own browser (s3) show the same header.

sources.shows: home: navy header, spark, hamburger, square Search field with department dropdown, reorder/account/store/cart icons without labels, hero carousel, NextDay delivery band, Feedback side tab

full home and white footer: newsletter field, social icons, Mobile apps, columns Walmart Services / Get to Know Us / Walmart.com / Customer Service / In The Spotlight (Our Company, Sell on Walmart.com, Careers, Terms of Use, Privacy & Security, Calif. Privacy Rights, Tax Exempt Program, Help Center, Product Recalls, Accessibility, Contact Us, Store Pickup)

search 'tablet' in a user's browser: navy header, 'Deliver to' row, '1 - 20 of 1,000+ results', 'Refine by | Price Top Brands Store Availability', 'Sort by | Best Match', category icon row, left Departments rail with Delivery & Pickup filters, list results with price and 'Show only Samsung Store'

search 'lego': sponsored brand banner, results count, Refine by (Price, Top Brands, Store Availability) as plain dropdowns, Sort by Best Match, list/grid toggles, category icon carousel with dots, Departments rail, ROLLBACK badge, 2-day delivery

product page: breadcrumb, share icons, image with thumbnails, 24px title, stars/reviews/brand/Walmart #, price, Free 2-day delivery, Free pickup, Add-on services (protection plan), quantity, blue pill Add to Cart, Sold & shipped by, Add to List / Add to Registry, 'Tell us if something is incorrect', other sellers
